chunks: As for whatever in it is from ʿĀmir ibn Jadhāʿah, I have transmitted it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from al-Ḥakam ibn Miskīn, from ʿĀmir ibn Jadhāʿah al-Azdī.
And he is ʿĀmir ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Jadhāʿah, and he is an Arab from Kufah.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: An honorific meaning 'may Allah be pleased with him.'
key_terms.عَامِرِ بْنِ جَذَاعَةَ الْأَزْدِيِّ: The named transmitter whose chain is being clarified.
key_terms.عَرَبِيٌّ كُوفِيٌّ: A biographical description meaning an Arab from Kufah.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿĀmir ibn Jadhāʿah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which al-Ṣadūq transmits narrations from ʿĀmir ibn Jadhāʿah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It also identifies him more precisely as ʿĀmir ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Jadhāʿah al-Azdī, an Arab from Kufah.
